mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weather_forecast (trip_id, forecast_date, city, min_temp, max_temp, precipitation, humidity, uv_index, weather_desc, fetch_time) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{forecastDate}, #{city}, #{minTemp}, #{maxTemp}, #{precipitation}, #{humidity}, #{uvIndex}, #{weatherDesc}, #{fetchTime})
